knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A hire should follow a written demand trigger that has been met for the set period, with the induction gate ready. Feeling overloaded, a competitor's move or the calendar are not triggers.
Supervision of first jobs confirms methods, safety and customer conduct before the worker is unsupervised. It is not about payment or client notice.
A competency record shows which tasks each person has been checked to perform, to standard and safely. It supports the induction gate and does not replace it.

practicalCriteria: The hiring trigger is written as a number and a rule, linked to the break-even figure.
The induction gate lists each topic and the sign-off required.
The lead criteria are listed, with the evidence required before a second team starts.
The pay and classification check is recorded as checked, with a source and an owner.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark (all 3 of 3 correct for this lesson). A quiz pass is not verified practical competence. The staffing plan and induction gate are assessed separately by an assessor against the practical criteria.
evidenceRequired: Staffing plan, trigger sheet and induction gate reviewed by an assessor
stopWorkCriteria: Stop any shift in which a new worker works unsupervised before induction sign-off.
Stop any engagement where worker classification or any required screening has not been checked.
